code: import{useState,useEffect}from'react';export function useLocalStorage(key,initialValue){const[storedValue,setStoredValue]=useState(()=>{try{const item=window.localStorage.getItem(key);return item?JSON.parse(item):initialValue;}catch{return initialValue;}});const setValue=value=>{try{const valueToStore=value instanceof Function?value(storedValue):value;setStoredValue(valueToStore);window.localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(valueToStore));}catch(e){console.error(e);}};return[storedValue,setValue];}export function getTodayKey(){return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);}
